text.jp:
……そうか。
……奴らは土のクリスタルを破壊したのか。
text.official_en: ...I see. So it was by their hand the Earth Crystal was shattered.

text.jp: ……レイン、ラスウェル。
text.official_en: Rain, Lasswell...

text.jp:
ああ、わかった。
ラスウェル、ナシャトに向かおうぜ。
text.official_en: Thanks, we’ll do that. Let’s get to Felicitas, Lasswell.
text.real_en: All right. Lasswell, let's head to Felicitas.

text.jp:
ああ。俺もそれがいいと思う。
二度と鎧の者に負けるわけにはいかないからな。
text.official_en: I agree. I’d rather not suffer any more humiliation at the hands of those armored warriors.
text.real_en: Yeah, I agree. We can't afford to lose to those armored warriors again.

text.jp: ありがとうございます、陛下。
text.official_en: Thank you, Your Majesty.

text.jp: いや……その……なんでもない。
text.official_en: It’s...um...nothing.

text.jp:
うむ……。
だが、今は追跡に多くの兵を割くわけにはいかん。
text.official_en: Indeed... However, with so few men to spare, its retrieval may prove difficult.
text.real_en: Indeed... But we can't spare many soldiers to pursue them right now.

text.jp: お前たち二人でコロボス遺跡に行くというのか……。
text.official_en: You intend on going there by yourselves?
text.real_en: You two intend to go to Kolobos Ruins on your own...?

text.jp: すぐにやつらを追ってナシャトの町に向かおう。
text.official_en: We should go after the armored warriors immediately. Let’s head to Felicitas.

text.jp:
すぐにナシャトの町ヘ行くのもいいが、
俺たちにはもっと力が必要なのかもしれん。
text.official_en: Heading straight to Felicitas is our most apparent course of action, but it might be prudent to be prepared for the worst.
text.real_en: We could head straight to Felicitas, but we might need more strength first.

text.jp:
その可能性もあるかもしれん。
だが……
text.official_en: It’s certainly plausible... However...
text.real_en: That's possible... But...

text.jp:
それがお前たちの探しているものかはわからないが、
地図に書いておいてやろう。
text.official_en: I am not entirely certain they are what the two of you are looking for, but I can mark them on your map.

text.jp: では、俺とラスウェルで確かめてきます。
text.official_en: I offer myself and Lasswell for the task.
text.real_en: Then Lasswell and I will go investigate.

text.jp: どうしたんだ？
text.official_en: What’s wrong, Lasswell?

text.jp: なんだ？　シャルロット。
text.official_en: Yeah, Charlotte?

text.jp:
はい。
だとすれば六盟傑もいる可能性もあるかと。
text.official_en: Yes, Your Majesty. It may also be where we find the Sworn Six.

text.jp:
まずはナシャトの町で情報を集めるといいだろう。
コロボス遺跡から一番近い町だからな。
text.official_en: ...I recommend heading to Felicitas first. It’s the closest town from the ruins.
text.real_en: You should gather information in Felicitas first. It's the closest town to Kolobos Ruins.

text.jp: まずはビジョンを探して、戦力強化をはかろう。
text.official_en: We should look for more visions first and bolster our fighting power.

text.jp:
まだ根城と確定したわけではありません。
陛下の仰る通り、兵を割くべきではないかと。
text.official_en: Yes, Your Majesty—seeing as we’ve yet to confirm the truth, and we haven’t the men to spare.
text.real_en: We still haven't confirmed that the ruins are their base. As Your Majesty said, we shouldn't divert any troops for this.

text.jp:
やつら、我が国の防衛の要である飛空艇を
全て破壊していきおった……
王都の復興のためにも、今は兵が必要だ……。
text.official_en: They’ve destroyed our fleet, depriving the realm of its defenses. We’ll need every hand we’ve got working on the capital’s recovery.
text.real_en: They destroyed every airship we had, the backbone of our country's defenses... We need our soldiers to rebuild the capital right now.

text.jp:
わかった。
お前がそう言うのならナシャトに向かおう。
ビジョンを探すのはそれからでも遅くない。
text.official_en: Understood. We’ll head to Felicitas then. We can always seek out the visions later.
text.real_en: All right. If that's what you want, let's head to Felicitas. We can look for visions afterward.

text.jp:
わかった。
レーゲンの息子のお前たちなら大丈夫だろう。
コロボス遺跡の調査は任せる。
text.official_en: Very well. As Sir Raegen’s sons, I have much faith in the both of you. I leave the investigation in your hands.
text.real_en: Very well. You're both Raegen's sons, so I'm sure you'll manage. I'll leave the investigation of Kolobos Ruins to you.

text.jp: コロボス遺跡が奴らの根城だというのか？
text.official_en: You’re saying the ruins have become their lair?
text.real_en: Are you saying Kolobos Ruins is their base?

text.jp: サンキュー、シャルロット。
text.official_en: Fantastic, thanks, Charlotte.
text.real_en: Thanks, Charlotte.

text.jp:
ビジョンは祠に祀られているらしいからな。
あとで俺が調べておこう。
text.official_en: They are apparently enshrined in sanctums. I’ll see if I can gather more intel on them.
text.real_en: Apparently visions are enshrined in sanctums. I'll look into it later.

text.jp: ビジョンを探しにいくってことか。
text.official_en: I see. You’re suggesting that we go find more visions.

text.jp:
ビジョンクリスタルは祠に祀られているんだったな。
すぐに調べてみよう。
text.official_en: The visions are apparently enshrined in sanctums. Let’s go investigate them.
text.real_en: The Vision Crystals are enshrined in sanctums, right? Let's look into it right away.

text.jp: レイン、お前はどう思う？
text.official_en: Yes, but ultimately I’ll leave it to your discretion, Rain. Let me hear your thoughts on the matter.
text.real_en: Rain, what do you think?

text.jp:
今のままでは、もう一度、鎧の者と戦っても、
同じ結果になるかもしれない。
text.official_en: I fear if we engage those armored warriors once more, the outcome will likely be the same.

text.jp: 今回の襲撃で俺たちは国も仲間も守れなかった。
text.official_en: We failed in our duty to protect our country and our brothers-in-arms in this last attack.
text.real_en: We couldn't protect our country or our comrades during the attack.

text.jp: 今回の襲撃と何か関係があるのかもしれません。
text.official_en: I believe there may be a connection.
text.real_en: There may be some connection to this attack.

text.jp: 他国からの侵略なのでしょうか。
text.official_en: Perhaps they’re an invasion force from another realm?
text.real_en: Could they be invaders from another country?

text.jp:
以前、大陸の地質調査に出たときに、
祠らしきものをいくつか見つけた。
text.official_en: When I was carrying out geological surveys of the continent before, I came across several locations that could be described as such.
text.real_en: I found several places that looked like sanctums during an earlier geological survey of the continent.

text.jp:
何か考えがあるようだな。
よい。お前たち二人に任せよう。
text.official_en: It seems you two have settled on a plan of action. Very well, you have my blessing to carry on.
text.real_en: It looks like you two have something in mind. Very well. I'll leave it to you.

text.jp:
六盟傑と幽鬼兵の軍……。
一体、奴らは何者なのだ？
text.official_en: This...Sworn Six, and an army of wraith soldiers... What manner of foe do we face?
text.real_en: The Sworn Six and an army of wraith soldiers... Who are they?

text.jp:
異界に行ったとき、光の意思は
ビジョンを集めて滅びに抗えと言った。
text.official_en: When we visited the Farplane, the Will of Light told us to take command of visions and fight against the forces of destruction.
text.real_en: When we went to the Farplane, the Will of Light told us to gather visions and resist destruction.

text.jp:
神器は７００年以上前から存在し
不思議な力を秘めていると聞いております。
text.official_en: I’ve heard, Your Majesty, that the relic has existed for over seven hundred years and holds a mysterious power.
text.real_en: I've heard that the relic has existed for over seven hundred years and holds a mysterious power.

text.jp:
神器を奪っていったのを考えると
もっと何か、よからぬことが起こっているのかもしれん。
text.official_en: ...with the Divine Signet stolen, I’m afraid something much darker may lurk upon the horizon.
text.real_en: Given that they stole the Divine Signet, something even more sinister may be going on.

text.jp: 祠……か。
text.official_en: About those “sanctums”...

text.jp:
陛下、城を襲った幽鬼兵ですが
先日、コロボス遺跡にて目撃された
正体不明の魔物と特徴が似ております。
text.official_en: Your Majesty, the wraith soldiers that laid siege to the castle—we spotted similar beings the other day at Kolobos Ruins.
text.real_en: Your Majesty, the wraith soldiers who attacked the castle resemble the unidentified monsters sighted at Kolobos Ruins the other day.

text.jp: （今はどちらを優先すべきだろうか……？）
text.official_en: (What’s our next move?)
text.real_en: Which should we prioritize right now...?
